operations.name: John Johnson

updates.sentence: 7 years and 2 months in federal prison, followed by 3 years of supervised release
updates.convicted: Federal jury conviction in May 2022 for assaulting a federal task force officer and brandishing a firearm in relation to a crime of violence

operations.source: DOJ November 9, 2022 sentencing release: https://www.justice.gov/usao-wdky/pr/cincinnati-man-sentenced-7-years-and-2-months-federal-prison-assaulting-and-brandishing . Refers to May of this year verdict; state one-year sentence is a separate proceeding. No release projected from 86-month sentence. Existing Civil Disorder charge label and 2021 arrest start warrant separate verification; populated fields preserved.

operations.name: Ben Boloff

expected.charges: Federal prosecution under the Espionage Act of 1917 and/or the Sedition Act of 1918.

updates.sentence: Ten years in the Oregon penitentiary; the sentencing court provided for suspension of the unserved portion upon obtaining a passport for deportation
updates.convicted: Criminal syndicalism under Oregon law; conviction affirmed October 20, 1931

operations.source: Original Oregon Supreme Court opinion, State v Boloff, 138 Or 568, 4 P2d326 (1931), identifies judge, state offense and ten-year term: https://case-law.vlex.com/vid/state-v-boloff-894294007 . AP contemporary sentencing report in March 3 Oregon Statesman: https://oregonnews.uoregon.edu/lccn/sn85042470/1931-03-03/ed-1/seq-1/ . March 1931 MONTH precision used because another report March 4 dates sentence March 3; no exact day asserted. Existing federal WWI charges label is incompatible with this 1930 Oregon case and flagged for separate correction, not overwritten.

operations.name: Cyan Bass

expected.charges: Charges arising from the 2020 George Floyd Uprising in Minneapolis

updates.plead: Guilty — five state counts, before July 19, 2021 conviction and sentencing

operations.source: Primary county DA December 2 charging report explicitly dates state arrest December 1: https://www.mcda.us/index.php/news/arson-suspect-accused-of-throwing-destructive-device-at-police-officer-indicted . July 19, 2021 sentencing report identifies plea and prosecutor: https://www.mcda.us/index.php/news/cyan-waters-bass-convicted-of-arson-and-assault-during-downtown-protest-receives-48-month-prison-sentence . This is the state prosecution, separate from the earlier federal arrest/release. No continuous December-to-release interval inferred, so admission stays blank. Existing biography says Minneapolis; primary records establish Portland. Populated text not overwritten, flagged.

operations.name: Mary Wilson

expected.charges: Charged with 'treason' under the Illinois criminal-syndicalism law.
expected.sentence:
Held; faced one to ten years.

Charges as recorded: Charged with 'treason' under the Illinois criminal-syndicalism law for gathering Communist ballot signatures.

operations.source: Contemporary Vilnis September 26, 1940 report, Lewistown Cases Face Grand Jury, identifies state attorney and assistant for the four defendants including Mary Wilson: https://www.spauda2.org/vilnis/archive/1940/1940-09-26-VILNIS.pdf . Facing one-to-ten years not treated as an imposed term. Justice of peace not mislabeled trial judge; no custody dates manufactured.

operations.name: Marjorie Kendrick

expected.name: Marjorie Kendrick
expected.description: Marjorie Kendrick was arrested outside the British Embassy on July 5, 1943 while picketing for the release of Mahatma Gandhi and Jawaharlal Nehru and supporting the Quit India movement.

updates.body:
Photo credit

Marjorie Kendrick at the British Embassy picket, July 5, 1943. Washington Area Spark identifies the three pickets from left to right as Kendrick, Jane Fulton and Harold Lefever in this photograph. Photographer unknown; the collection describes an auction-acquired print and marks all rights reserved. Exact crop (660, 360, 950, 710) from the downloaded 2048 by 1648 JPEG; retained pixels unchanged. Source JPEG preserved in the batch archive. No open license asserted. Collection photograph and caption.

operations.source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/washington_area_spark/29073204244 . Meridian exhibition uses a different ordering in its caption; identification here follows the caption attached to this specific photographed arrangement. No confinement interval inferred from photo.
